defects.claim: The second acceptance bullet asks the PR body to list every field that falls back to `—` and the endpoint that would supply it. The PR body has no "Needs API" section. It only repeats the issue text and pastes the build, test and lint output. The fields that render `—` are listed only in a code docblock (src/design-system/components/ContextPanel.vue:11-15): Docs created and read counts, all Memory values and all Graph values. So this requirement is not met.

The Docs header value is a client recount (`docs.entries.length`), and docsUpdated at :30-34 filters the same `entries`. The type contract forbids this. src/lib/api/types.ts:644-645 says "never client-recount `entries`, the tree response may cap/paginate individual entries independently of these totals". The mock already slices entries on `limit` (src/lib/api/mockAdapter.ts:1724), so a capped tree would undercount the header and "Updated this week".

The panel sits inside the `hidden … md:grid` container, so it never renders below the md breakpoint. The issue says "stacked under the main column below that", but the mobile glance block (DashboardView.vue:373) has no Context panel.
Rows show only one value. The "count left of a muted secondary number" anatomy is not built, and no trim is written in the docblock. The issue says "where available", so this is minor.
`Drift` is coloured `text-needs-you`, the Review-needed accent token (src/design-system/theme.css:27 `--color-needs-you: #b04a92`), not a warning tone. That reuses a token for a different meaning.

No DashboardView test checks that `loadContextDocs` calls `getDocsTree` or that `ContextPanel` gets mounted. A grep for `getDocsTree|ContextPanel` in src/views/__tests__ finds only DocsView.spec.ts. The spec covers the component in isolation, not the wiring at DashboardView.vue:246-261.
